sentences.text:
The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants Mahendra Singh, Sarvesh Devi, Komal, Hari Singh and Hemant Kumar with the following prayers:
"It is therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to quash the entire criminal proceeding against the applicants in pursuance of the charge sheet dated 13.06.2023 in Criminal Misc. Case No. 09 of 2023, Case Crime No. 08 of 2023, State V/s Hemant Kumar & others, under Section 498A, 323,
504, 506 IPC & 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Mahila Thana, District Hathras, pending before the F.T.C-2 Hathras, District Hathras.

It is further prayed that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to stay the further proceeding of Criminal Misc. Case No. 09 of 2023, Case Crime No. 08 of 2023, State V/s Hemant Kumar & others, under Section 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC & 3/4 D.P. Act,
P.S. Mahila Thana, District Hathras, pending before the F.T.C-2 Hathras, District Hathras.
And/or pass such other and further order which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit on the facts and circumstances of the present case."
5 Since there is no representation on behalf of learned counsel for the applicants to press this 482 petition even in the revised list, the application is dismissed for want of prosecution.
6. Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
7. Office to communicate this order to the trial court concerned within two weeks.

Order Date :- 4.12.2024 Arti (Samit Gopal,J.)
